title: open-design: a local, open-source alternative to Anthropic's Claude Design

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Anthropic cloud design generates productionready UI on a canvas, but it's closed source, cloudon, and paywalled. Open design is the local first open- source alternative. Plugs into claude code, cursor, codec, Gemini CLI, open code, and local Quinn. 19 design skills, 71 branded design systems. Chat in your terminal. It renders into a sandbox preview, then exports straight to HTML, PDF, or PowerPoint.
